title: SLoSa: Small, Low-Power, and Safe Foundation Models for Robotic Task Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset

translated_title: SLoSa：面向机器人任务规划的小型、低功耗且安全的基础模型
translated_abstract: 安全的机器人任务规划要求规划器能够在满足安全约束的同时可靠地实现任务目标。经典规划器在显式符号任务表示上进行搜索，可以针对编码的安全约束提供形式化保证，但需要严格的输入格式，且其计算成本会随着搜索空间的增大而迅速增加。相比之下，大语言模型（LLM）提供了灵活的任务接口和强大的泛化能力，但它们体积庞大、功耗高，且预训练过程中几乎没有机器人特定的安全数据和知识，因此难以在资源受限的机器人系统上本地部署。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了SLoSa，一个用于训练基于基础模型的机器人任务规划器的神经符号压缩与微调框架，使规划器具备小尺寸、低功耗需求和安全意识。该框架首先构建一个安全感知的数据集……
tldr: 提出SLoSa框架，通过神经符号压缩与微调训练出体积小、功耗低且具备安全意识的机器人任务规划基础模型，融合了经典规划器的形式化安全保证与大语言模型的灵活泛化能力。
en_tdlr: SLoSa is a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework that trains small, low-power, and safety-aware foundation models for robotic task planning, combining the formal safety guarantees of classical planners with the flexibility of large language models.
